# @mrmeg/expo-ui

Docs, in `node_modules/@mrmeg/expo-ui/`:

- README.md — install, setup, theme, component guide, release.
- LLM_USAGE.md — concise component-selection and implementation rules.
- llms-full.md — expanded contract, component catalog, notifications.

Public entrypoints (nothing else is importable):

- @mrmeg/expo-ui
- @mrmeg/expo-ui/components, /components/*
- @mrmeg/expo-ui/constants, /constants/*
- @mrmeg/expo-ui/hooks, /hooks/*
- @mrmeg/expo-ui/state, /state/*
- @mrmeg/expo-ui/lib

Never import from /dist/*, a source checkout, or an app-local copy.

Do not recreate primitives this package provides; compose the exports.

Call useResources() once near the Expo app root. Mount UIProvider once near the
root: it owns Notification, StatusBar, the @rn-primitives portal host, and the
native keyboard-avoiding root. Required before Dialog, AlertDialog, BottomSheet,
Drawer, DropdownMenu, Popover, SelectContent, Tooltip, and notify. On native,
mount react-native-keyboard-controller's KeyboardProvider above UIProvider.

BottomSheet renders the platform's native sheet via @expo/ui, which owns
gestures and keyboard avoidance; swipeEnabled, avoidKeyboard, and
dismissKeyboardOnDrag are accepted but ignored.

Use useTheme(), useStyles(), semantic tokens, StyledText, and package controls.
Do not add app-local Appearance or matchMedia listeners for theme sync. On web
theme colors are CSS variables: use withAlpha(color, alpha), never hex-suffix
concatenation.

i18n is optional. Plain children and text props work without app i18n. Use
configureExpoUiI18n() only to translate package tx props.
